hooks.name: Migrations are expand-only
hooks.description: Reminds that migrations are expand-only: an applied migration must never be edited, only a new one added.

action.prompt: You just changed packages/database/src/migrations.ts. Migrations in this project are expand-only and an already-applied migration must never be edited, because production has run it. Confirm you only appended a new migration with a fresh id. If you modified the SQL of an existing one, revert that part and add a new migration instead. Also check that the change is backward compatible with the currently deployed image, since the migration runs before the new image is live.
